name: Kashidashi Tsuma, Mayumi no "Netorase" Houkoku Binkan Tsuma to Furin Shucchou
original_name: 貸し出し妻、真由美の“ネトラセ”報告 敏感妻と不倫出張
source:
The protagonist, Kousaka Yasutomo, stumbled upon an online post one day.
It was a story about someone letting another man sleep with their wife. Intrigued, Yasutomo couldn’t stop thinking about it.

His wife, Mayumi, had only ever been with him. What would it be like for her to be with another man?
The thought spiraled into a full-blown fantasy, and eventually, he couldn’t hold it in anymore. He confessed his desire to Mayumi.

At first, Mayumi refused. But Yasutomo’s persistence wore her down, and she finally agreed—on one condition.
“Only if it’s a man I trust…”
And so, the person my wife chose as her "loanee" was her one-year-younger, divorced boss, Shinkai Satoru—the only man she trusted besides me.
Since Satoru often went on business trips, that’s when the "loans" would take place.

The forbidden Affair Business Trip Sex.
What kind of intimacy unfolded between the two of them?
I wouldn’t know until my wife came home.

translation:
主人公高坂靖友某天偶然看到一则网络帖子。那是关于有人让另一个男人和自己妻子上床的故事。靖友对此产生兴趣，脑中不断浮现相关想象。

他的妻子真由美只和他发生过关系。她和另一个男人在一起，会是什么感觉？

这个念头逐渐变成完整幻想，最终他再也无法忍耐，向真由美坦白了欲望。

起初，真由美拒绝了。但靖友坚持不懈，终于让她答应，条件只有一个：

“只有那个我信任的男人才行……”

于是，妻子选择的“借出对象”，是比她小一岁的离婚上司新开悟——除了我以外唯一信任的男人。悟经常出差，“借出”便会在出差期间进行。

禁忌的出轨出差性爱。

两人之间展开了怎样的亲密关系？

只有妻子回家后，我才会知道。
